_note: M-LOADOUT PerkCatalog (docs/spec/loadout.md §1.2). A perk is the third slot of a player's kit (A14, 2026-09-04: beside the weapons; the ALT-button accessibility switch moved OUT of this slot in S50 -- see `easy_reload` below). v1 perks are PASSIVE: pure head-frame tweaks the compiler already knows how to write ($PSET armor/shield, $AMMO + $WEAP ammo/reload tokens, a $SIR key swap). `mechanism: slot_frame` rows would be a $WEAP in slot 1 whose effect lives in the VICTIM's $SIR table (game-wide, not per-player) — they stay `hidden` until the emit-side bench proves them. `verified` = effect proven on hardware. Copy is player-facing: no protocol jargon. S50 (2026-09-17, perk balance pass): every perk now trades on the SAME lever its opposite buys, so the set is rock/paper/scissors instead of a ladder. `effects.max_armor_add` here is the perk's ABSOLUTE grant AT THE DEFAULT 45+70 POOL, kept as a plain integer because `app/src/hud/hud.js` and `webapp/mc/src/screens/Kit.tsx` both render it literally as '+N ARMOR' -- it is DOCUMENTATION, not the compiled number: `compile.py`'s `_POOL_GRANT_PCT` is the one place the real, pool-scaled percentage lives, and it is keyed by `perk_id`, not read out of this field. body_armor is +20% of hp+armor (was a flat +50, S50's 'straight upgrade' finding); quick_switch is -8%, both floored at 0 and capped at 255 by `compile.armed_armor`/`armed_shield`. In a game whose base armour is 0 (the coming Shields preset), body_armor's grant compiles into the SHIELD ceiling instead of armour (`compile.is_shields_preset`).

perks.name: Body Armor
perks.desc: Start every life with extra armor -- about a fifth of the game's health pool (+23 at the usual 45 HP / 70 armor). Armor soaks hits before your health does. The rig is heavier though: your reload takes a quarter longer.

perks.name: Extended Mags
perks.desc: Double the magazine and double the reserve on your primary. Fewer reloads, longer fights, more rounds to burn -- but the bulkier magazine slows your draw: switching to your other weapon takes 30% longer.

perks.name: Quick Hands
perks.desc: Reload in half the time. Your primary is back in the fight before theirs is -- the trade is a lighter magazine, 20% fewer rounds carried.

perks.name: Quick Switch
perks.desc: Draw your second weapon in half the time: the gun's swap delay drops from 0.85 s to 0.43 s. A lighter rig means less padding though -- about a twelfth of the game's health pool comes off your armor (-9 at the usual 45 HP / 70 armor).

perks.name: Armor Piercing
perks.desc: Your primary ignores armor and shields, straight to health -- but it hits for less than half as hard, so it is only the better choice against an armored or shielded target.

perks.name: Med Kit
perks.desc: A healing shot for teammates — tag an ally to top up their health.

perks.name: Concussion
perks.desc: A stun burst that jams an enemy's weapon for a few seconds.
